Maya G.: Quick weekly check-in for AcmeCorp (acct ACME-123). Heads up — spending vs commit looking risky for hosted API this billing period. :warning:
Maya G.: Commit: $8,000/mo. MTD spend: $7,900. Last 24h burn +35% vs prior 24h => projected overage ~ $1.2k if rate holds.
Maya G.: Also seeing a latency jump on text-generation routes (99p: 420ms from ~210ms) and error rate climbed to 1.8% (was 0.2%).
Jordan P.: @Maya G. do we know which model or route is driving the spike? request mix change?
Maya G.: Early look shows a lot of traffic to /v1/generate-stream and high token-per-request on model redwood-xlarge. Suspect a partner integration started load testing overnight.
BillingBot: AutoAlert: spend_burn_rate(account=ACME-123) > 110% threshold. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/acct/ACME-123/usage :money_with_wings:
Ops-Alerts: Metric anomaly detected: generation_errors > baseline (p=0.01), latency_99 > baseline (p=0.02). Correlated with model=redwood-xlarge.
Liam R.: If it's streaming + large context, kernel fallback and KV cache pressure could explain latency. We can temporarily route ACME-123 to redwood-large-quant for lower cost/latency.
Jordan P.: Proposal: 1) notify customer and pause partner testing window, 2) apply soft quota or rate limit on streaming route, 3) fallback model for 2h, 4) schedule enablement call to review best practices.
Maya G.: I'll ping the customer now. Jordan, can you action the soft quota? Liam, can you stage the fallback?
Jordan P.: On it — creating adjustment in console now. Command I ran: 
```
POST /admin/accounts/ACME-123/quota
{ "route": "/v1/generate-stream", "limit_rps": 8, "window": "10s" }
```
Jordan P.: Added temporary quota, alerting if throttle hits >60% during business hours.
Liam R.: Preparing fallback rollout: will add traffic-splitting rule to send 20% -> redwood-large-quant, 80% -> redwood-xlarge for 30m canary. If errors persist, escalate to 100% fallback.
Maya G.: Thanks. Customer confirm call at 1700 PT today. Action items:
- Maya G.: customer comms and call (1700 PT) :phone:
- Jordan P.: quota in place (done) and monitor spend burn :bar_chart:
- Liam R.: fallback canary staged (ETA 10m) :gear:
- BillingBot/Ops-Alerts: continue monitoring and post updates here.
Jordan P.: Quick note — estimated avoided overage if fallback reduces token usage by 30%: ~$360 this period.
Maya G.: Good. Will capture feedback during call about prompt batching and caching. Also ask them to share partner's test plan so we can recommend throttles.
Ops-Alerts: Next automated update in 15m.
